'''Falcon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]] he determined that [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces were hiding their transmissions by bouncing them between the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen to destroy the droids involved.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Falcon appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], who begins the mission "Jam the Transmissions."
